proposal.description: Chip-select deassert is taken straight from the unfiltered synchronised CS_n, so only selection goes through the glitch filter, as if 'deselect must be immediate'
proposal.reason: A CS_n glitch high shorter than the 8-clock filter in the middle of a transaction now reaches spi_slave as a cs_rise and aborts it. CS also now rises 8 clocks ahead of the filtered SCK and MOSI, so a master that raises CS within 160 ns of its last SCK edge has its final CRC bit cut off and the write is discarded.

proposal.description: strike_counter is handed the strike limit minus one, a second off-by-one fix on top of the one strike_counter already makes by comparing with max_strikes-1
proposal.reason: With the default limit of 3, latch_out (and so the shared SCR latch, Red_LED1 and the S_OFF lockout) trips on the 2nd hiccup entry instead of the 3rd. The two-retries-then-latch sequence becomes one retry.

proposal.description: The UVLO debouncer is copied from the SPI glitch filters, so input undervoltage qualifies in 8 clocks (160 ns) both ways instead of the fault-flag 1 ms assert and 200 us release
proposal.reason: An input-rail sag or changeover transient longer than 160 ns but shorter than 1 ms now asserts UVLO. That drops En, sends the supervisor to S_OFF and lights Red_LED3 on a healthy board. A real UVLO also releases after 160 ns instead of 200 us, so the converter restarts sooner.
